notes.title: Update 0815
notes.content:
1. Fix the problem that the position of the pub HUD interactive board is not aligned.
2. Fix the bug that Alan was standing diagonally when George first entered the door.
3. Fix the bug that the protagonist animation's legs reverse when adding engine oil.
4. Delete the reminder to fill up the engine oil. Somewhat long-winded.
5. The HUD logic of the interactive board has been optimized for the second time. Now the fade-in and fade-out displacements of all interactive boards are unified.
6. Fixed the problem that the HUD prompts that the position is too high at the beginning of the snow mountain.
7. The second optimization of the interactive board, the z value and the drawing animation are all unified.
8. Fix the bug that the setting panel UI does not become white due to the previous modification of the time manager.
9. Add fade-in animation to the buttons on the main interface.
10. The grilling part goes back, and the dialog box position is incorrect. Fixed the problem.
11. When the grill part triggers Cutscene, a very large interactive board will flash, and the problem is fixed.
12. The hotel removes the mural interaction, which is of little significance.
13. The AD button prompt on the big map disappears after selection and no longer stays for a long time.
14. Fix the problem that the camera will shake after the restaurant interacts.
15. Driving out to trigger the house exterior scene gradually appeared prematurely, the problem was fixed.
16. The entire frame in the hotel moved to the right, and the black bar on the left was fixed.
